mapper.sql: id, report_id, provider, consent_record_id, consent_declared_at, created_by, status, attempt_count, provider_request_id, raw_text_ciphertext, raw_extraction_ciphertext, error_code, next_retry_at, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ocr_job (report_id, provider, consent_record_id, consent_declared_at, created_by, status, attempt_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{provider}, #{consentRecordId}, #{consentDeclaredAt}, #{createdBy}, #{status}, #{attemptCount}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ocr_job WHERE report_id = #{reportId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ocr_job SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', provider_request_id = #{providerRequestId}, raw_text_ciphertext = #{rawTextCiphertext}, raw_extraction_ciphertext = #{rawExtractionCiphertext}, error_code = NULL, finished_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE ocr_job SET status = 'FAILED', error_code = #{errorCode}, next_retry_at = NULL, finished_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM ocr_job WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= #{now}) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
